title: A closer look at a toe
hook: A toe pad has a surprising surface.

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors that can be investigated.
doesNotKnow: The magnified toe shows many branching structures meeting a surface. These fine structures help a gecko make close contact and adhere; the sketch is not to scale and does not show every physical force involved.

misconception: The evidence in the scenario supports a different interpretation.
objective: A gecko climbs a clean vertical surface. What do many tiny structures on its toe pads help it do?

claims.text: A toe pad has a surprising surface. A gecko climbs a clean vertical surface. What do many tiny structures on its toe pads help it do? The magnified toe shows many branching structures meeting a surface. These fine structures help a gecko make close contact and adhere; the sketch is not to scale and does not show every physical force involved.

claims.text: The toe structures are greatly enlarged and reduced to a few lines; no nanoscale force is directly measured.
Why are many fine toe structures useful in this simplified adhesion picture? Fine structures allow extensive close contact between the toe and a surface.
